title: Truth Table — Loyalty Quarters of Dividend Cushion on Class H Preferred Stock Purchases, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The loyalty quarters of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding rest on whether the holding keeps reinvesting and how long it has been held: a holding with a reinvested dividend dated within the last 3 whole months and issued at least 120 whole months before today gives 2 quarters; a holding meeting exactly one of those two conditions gives 1 quarter; a holding meeting neither gives none.

## Truth table

| Reinvested dividend dated within the last 3 whole months | Issued at least 120 whole months before today | Loyalty quarters |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Yes | No | 1 |
| No | Yes | 1 |
| No | No | None |

The months are whole calendar months — counted back from today for the reinvested dividend, and from the holding's issue date to today for its age. The loyalty quarters are cushion quarters, added to any other cushion quarters of the holding; each cushion quarter keeps one quarter's coming reinvested dividend clear of the holding room when the member buys.

**Hypothetical cases.** A holding issued 130 whole months ago whose latest reinvested dividend is dated 1 month ago gives 2 quarters; the same holding with its latest reinvested dividend dated 5 months ago gives 1; a holding issued 40 whole months ago with a reinvested dividend 1 month ago gives 1.
